notes.title: 15.12.2019 Christmas update [christmas_fsru]
notes.content:
We had been working on Christmas update since October, now we can present it to you. You can read about other news below in the "about other news" block.

[h1]Major changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Happy new year 2020!
There was so many things in 2019 and we want to thank you for playing Stigfinnare! As a gift, we updated main menu and removed some bugs from the game 🎁
[*] Stigfinnare description in Steam updated
Our only marketer decided that "crazy men with a hairdryer" is more attractive than a "conceptually new shooter" and the only artist agreed. If you think else, write to our only SMM specialist, and our only community manager will consider your suggestion.
[*] New achievements
Let's remember old memes and press F to achievement "Now you are clear"

notes.title: 15.11.2019 HEALTH UPDATE [aru]
notes.content:
Health update is all about fixing several issues and investing in better technology to make sure we keep growing strong in the upcoming years.

[h1] Fixed critical bugs and glitches [/h1]
[list]
[*] Bug fixed when a player falling through entire KOTH map
[*] Bug fixed when game gets fatal error in 100% cases during loading Camouflage map
[/list]

[h1] Fixed bug [/h1]
[list]
[*] Bug fixed when player saw every skin in lobby like its
[*] Bug fixed when after choosing color, player always get purple (material error in game engine)
[*] Bug fixed when everybody can dry infinity time on KOTH map
[/list]

[h1] Minor bug fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Weekly challenges working again
[*] Energy counters now working fine on Electrize map
[*] Bug fixed when chat did not opening
[*] New game cannot be started after leaving inventory menu / private lobby / about screen
[*]
[/list]

[h1] Other changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] We completely redesigned inventory and character customization interface
[*] We updated assets for Steam library
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35177615/50c8772d8f3f7413a2e967c2853ff36361190ab0.png[/img]
[*] Fixed bug, when server can be overloaded by spam clicking on "Create lobby" button
[*] We added an unexpected or undocumented feature included as a joke or a bonus in Stigfinnare
[*] Rooms splitted
[*] Language localization improved
[*] Stigfinnare graphics improved by implementing own post-effect processing asset for each map
[*] New items added and improved icons and images of old items
[*] utidteam.com and stigfinnare.utidteam.com updated
[*] 13 hints added to game
[/list]

[h1] Balance [/h1]
We also made some changes to the GL5 damage on Destruction map. We heard that players can not kill enemies after hitting. Previously, the damage from hit was 20 HP in any part of the body except the head; 25 HP to the head; We conclude that damage must be increased.
[list]
[*] Damage from hit with a GL5 pistol changed to 35 HP and 80 HP to head
[/list]

Tommorow we'll release patch, updating balance and fixing few bugs

notes.title: 15.10.2019 REALLEASE [ru]
notes.content:
UTID team presents [b]Camouflage [/b]- the last map in [i]Party Games 2019[/i] pack. Also read about trap breaking and other updates in this note.

[h1]Most important[/h1]
[list]
[*] Camouflage is the final map in the 2019 pack. 6 players are split into 2 teams - [i]Hiders [/i]and [i]Seekers[/i]. The first team has [i]ColorZ [/i]- ultra-laser gun that fully repainting player into selected color. The second team has the only boomerang, which they can beat hiders. Read more about [i]Camouflage [/i]on [url=https://stigfinnare.fandom.com/ru/wiki/Camouflage]Stigfinnare wiki[/url] (rus).
[*] Breaking traps
Runners are now able to break any trap on the [i]Trapdoor [/i]map. Search traps by holding E button.
[/list]

[h1]Fix that [spoiler]Fixed[/spoiler][/h1]
[list]
[*] Private lobbies now have own server
[*] Smoother opening of Weekly challenges
[*] Smoother opening 2019 pack
[/list]

[h1]Breaking news[/h1]
[list]
[*] [url=http://discord.gg/tdrS3Vk]Stigfinnare discord server[/url] was closed due to low activity :c
[*] Credits screen remaked
[*] Development and support of Stigfinnare can be paused due to low financing. Support us - [url=http://donationalerts.com/r/vityaschel]http://donationalerts.com/r/vityaschel[/url]
[/list]

Thank you for being with us all the time in Early Access. We updated Stigfinnare like we were expecting. We going to gift all rewards for purchases during early access in the next updates. See you in release version! :)

notes.title: 27.09.2019 Stigfinnare 2.0 (1.0) update [prlu2]
notes.content:
Stigfinnare is leaving from early access. It now has inventory, weekly challenges, private-lobby-kicks, and other features. Check this little list.

[h1]First things first[/h1]
[list]
[*] Inventory
The inventory system was added to Stigfinnare. Buy skins and other things on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/market/search?appid=1068510]Community Market[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/1068510/]shop[/url].
[*] King of The Hill map rework
[*] Trailer
A new Stigfinnare trailer was recorded.
[previewyoutube=z01BgXI05M0;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] Weekly challenges
Complete them to level up!
[/list]

[h1]Harder, Better[/h1]
[list]
[*] Discord Rich Presence support
We still waiting for verification of [url=http://discord.gg/tdrS3Vk]Stigfinnare server[/url].
[*] Changed Bill's animations
[*] Added private-lobby-kicks
Someone else joined the room? Kick him out
[*] Character's hand renewed
We've spent $15 for this model. Please, [url=http://patreon.com/vityaschel]help us with donate[/url].
[/list]

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] New stats for GL5
Now its damaging 30 HP instead of 25 like before
[*] Overlay's bug
Unfortunately, all players have been caged in the main menu. We've fixed that.
[*] Rooms list reloading delay is now 0 seconds
[*] Votekicks start working
[/list]

[h1]Minor changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Credits screen edited.
[/list]

[h1]Thats not all[/h1]
UTID team did not have time to finish everything before the deadline. We will release another update in mid-October. Here is a list of what we will add:
[list]
[*] Animations of breaking and placing traps on [i]Trapdoor[/i]
[*] Improved character animations
[*] Improved weekly challenges
[/list]

Thanks for helping us [url=http://patreon.com/vityaschel] with donates[/url]. 
If you see a bug, why don't you tell about it on the [url=http://discord.gg/tdrS3Vk] discord server [/url]? 
Do not forget about [url=https://stats.utidteam.com] player statistics site [/url] 
We have [url=http://reddit.com/r/stigfinnare] subreddit [/url] and [url=http://stigfinnare.fandom.com/en/wiki/] wiki (RUS)[/url].

notes.title: 26.06.2019 ULTIMULTIMEDIA update [pru2]
notes.content:
O, privet! Last month, we should have to release Stigfinnare and add anti-cheat, but we just watched movies and were sick <3
Anyway, here is a small list of changes:

[h1]Balance changes: [/h1]
[list]
[*] We changed weapon recoil.
[*] Currently you will not die permanently on KOTH map
[/list]
[h1] Some features: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Hairdryer can now overheat and turn off after 0.5s and recharge after 1.1s
[/list]
[h1] "What should have been early" rubric: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Private lobbies - you can play with your friends on dedicated [strike]server[/strike] [strike]lobby[/strike] room! 
[*] VOTEKICK CHEATERS, GRIEFERS, ANY PLAYERS!
[*] We added energy spheres on team spawns on the Electrize map. 
[*] Trapdoor: we changed the texture of the road and added dirt to beautiful textures.
[/list]
[h1] "Oh, wow, fixed": [/h1]
[list]
[*] Pause now works correctly.
[*] Now when you kill someone, the player is falling instead of disappearing.
[*] On the Trapdoor map, you can see how another player was blinded by the Flash trap, and it will not work on other people.
[*] We added bans.
[/list]
[h1] Planning in future: [/h1]
Inventory system, shop, and anti-cheat.
We almost completed the spectator-mode. (:
[h1] Other super-important changes: [/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now see the latest news and you can even click on the link by clicking the button.
[*] Click on "Report a Player" button in context menu and you will report him
[*] Discord doesn't verified our server D:
[/list]
[h1] Some statistics: [/h1]
In June, the Stigfinnare page on Steam was visited by 530+ visitors, and 24+ people were added game to wishlist.

Do not forget about our Discord [url=http://discord.gg/tdrS3Vk]server[/url] and [url=http://patreon.com/vityaschel]Patreon[/url]

Glory to Artstozka!
Glory to gaben!

notes.title: 04.06.2019 RELEASE UPDATE [prdu1]
notes.content:
Today or not we release or do not release Stigfinnare. What is mean "release", who created this word? Anyway, here is a patch note about notes in patch:
[h1]Balance[/h1]
We were notified by testers about too easy wins at [i]electrize[/i] map so we make some changes in balance:
[list]
[*]Now you can't use a knife before the last attempt ends
[*]After spawning, you will have spawn-protection for a few seconds 
[/list]
[h1]Controls[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now you can crouch and it will be visible to other players. This function is still in beta, so there is a chance that you will sit down and no longer can stand up...
[/list]
[h1]Cosmetic changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bill will now be flying close to the floor
[*] You can saw that player have different things in hands so we fixed that
[/list]
[h1] Other changes [/h1]
Many small features and fixes have been added

[url=http://discord.gg/tdrS3Vk] We are waiting for you and your feedback on our discord server.[/url]
